speaker: Elder Alfred Kyungu
title: Using the Language of Peacemakers
session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder Alfred Kyungu spoke about “Using the Language of Peacemakers”.

quotes.text: As the last speaker of the Sunday morning session of the April 2026 general conference, President Dallin H. Oaks said: “My brothers and sisters, as followers of Christ, let us follow Him by forgoing contention and by using the language and methods of peacemakers. In our families and other personal relationships, let us avoid what is harsh and hateful.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Alfred Kyungu
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: As he concluded the conference on Sunday afternoon, President Oaks extended an invitation to all of us. He said, “As the messages from this conference are published, we invite all to study and ponder them prayerfully and to act in faith on the principles they explain.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Alfred Kyungu
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: This invitation to forgo contention by using the language of peacemakers comes from the living prophet. It is not a simple suggestion; it is a call to discipleship as we follow Jesus Christ.
quotes.speaker: Elder Alfred Kyungu
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: I began pondering on President Oaks’s invitation and how I could act with faith accordingly. It is a spiritual exercise to identify the language and expressions we need to forgo and then replace them with words and phrases that bring peace wherever we are and at all times.
quotes.speaker: Elder Alfred Kyungu
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: From ancient times, the Lord has counseled His people to avoid contention, dispute, and language that create conflict. In Proverbs we read, “These six things doth the Lord hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him.” Among them are “a lying tongue, … a false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Alfred Kyungu
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: The Apostle Paul wrote to the Ephesians, “Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Alfred Kyungu
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Likewise, in Colossians the Saints were counseled to be wise even in their speech: “Let your speech be alway with grace, … that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Alfred Kyungu
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: I believe that all of us in this mortal journey have been hurt by some form of humiliating, degrading, or discouraging language from a family member, a colleague at work, a friend, or even a fellow member of the Church.
quotes.speaker: Elder Alfred Kyungu
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference
